function.name: trust_managed_policy
function.description: Evaluate a managed policy. action=load returns the loaded policy and rule counts; action=check takes {tool,command,path} and returns allow|deny plus matched rules (deny wins; missing/invalid policy or missing default => deny); action=list returns a summary and the last 20 audit records. Reads GAMAI_POLICY (default ~/.config/gamai/trust/policy.json). This is an evaluator, not an enforcement point.

tool.description: tool name, e.g. shell or plugin__trust__managed_policy

command.description: shell command or action text to evaluate

function.name: trust_marketplace_verify
function.description: Verify package integrity without executing it: SHA-256 for every file, a manifest (manifest.json|TRUST.json|trust.json) with a files map, and an Ed25519 signature. Without a pinned public key (argument or GAMAI_TRUST_PUBKEY), a valid self-signature is reported as self_signed and is not trusted. Detects missing, mismatched, unexpected and symlinked content.

public_key.description: pinned Ed25519 public key (PEM, 64 hex chars, or base64 raw 32-byte key); also GAMAI_TRUST_PUBKEY

function.name: protean_run
function.description: Run a command inside a lease-bound sandbox. risk=low -> bubblewrap with a minimal read-only root and 32 MiB /tmp; medium -> Docker runc (--network=none, cap-drop ALL, read-only, tmpfs /tmp); high -> Docker + seccomp allowlist (or gVisor if available); critical -> denied locally unless remote=true and a remote host is configured. Only the first executable token is checked; shell syntax can run other binaries inside the sandbox. Unknown risk/substrate, invalid or expired lease, TTL overflow, net=true for medium/high/critical, and executables outside the allowlist are denied (fail-closed). Returns rc, clipped stdout/stderr, ms, substrate, genome_hash, lease_id, out_sha256 and evidence path.

cmd.description: Command to execute inside the sandbox (1..4096 chars, no NUL). Only the first executable token is checked against the allowlist.

risk.description: Risk class selects the substrate. critical requires remote=true plus a configured remote host.

net.description: Allow network. Default false. Only risk=low supports net=true; medium/high/critical are network-isolated.

timeout_s.description: Execution timeout in seconds (default 20). Lease TTL is derived from it and verified before execution.

workdir.description: Absolute working directory inside the sandbox (default /tmp). Must not contain ..; the directory must exist in the sandbox.

remote.description: Only for risk=critical: run on the configured remote host over SSH with gVisor. Denied for lower risks.

function.name: team_create
function.description: Create a team for a goal. The coordinator deterministically splits the goal into subtasks (no LLM), assigns them to members and creates an isolated workspace under ~/.cache/gamai/teams/<id>/ (shared clone or plain directory). State persists in ~/.local/state/gamai/teams/<id>.json. args: goal (required), agents (integer 2-8 or list of agent names; default 2), repo (optional git repo for a shared clone). Returns {ok, team_id, agents, tasks, isolation, state_path}.

agents.description: number of agents (2-8) or a list of agent names, e.g. ["agent-a","agent-b"]; default 2

repo.description: optional path to a git repo; a shared clone with hooks disabled is created

function.name: team_dispatch
function.description: Dispatch ONE task to ONE team member. task may be an existing task id (t1) or new text (added and assigned to the least-loaded member). Makes at most one optional LLM call through the configured HTTP(S) endpoint (GAMAI_LLM_URL); redirects are not followed and public plain HTTP is refused. If the LLM is unavailable or the budget is exhausted, returns a deterministic fallback and records it in engine. Re-dispatching a finished task is cached (no LLM). Returns {ok, team_id, task_id, assignee, engine, result, llm_calls, results_done, team_done, summary}.

task.description: task id (t1) or new task text

function.name: team_status
function.description: Return persistent team state (survives sessions/processes): goal, members, tasks with results, progress, LLM call count, isolated workspace and file list. args: team_id.
